channel.description: Latest articles from The Old House Life (theoldhouselife.com)

item.title: Unique floors! Pretty porch! Circa 1905 in Washington. $335,000
item.description: This house has unique wood floors! I love the porch and the staircase! The house was built in 1905. It is located in Asotin, Washington. The house features a pretty wrap around front porch, unique wood floors, stained glass transom windows, picture rails, nice staircase, unpainted woodwork, wide baseboards, vintage light fixtures and solid wood doors. If you pull up street view you can see the house has pretty scenery. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,842 square feet. $335,000 Contact Witney Br

item.title: 19 acres! Stone cottage in West Virginia. $193,000
item.description: This stone cottage has a lot of potential! Nice acreage with it! The cottage was built in 1945. It is located on 19 acres in Alum Creek, West Virginia. The house features a stone exterior, wood floors, stone fireplace and baseboards. The house needs some updating and some undoing of past renovations. I would have taken pictures with blinds open. But the price seems reasonable with the acreage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,725 square feet. $193,000 Contact Christa Vance with Old Colony: 304

item.title: Pretty creek! Pretty kitchen floor! C. 1890 in North Carolina. $339,000
item.description: I love the creek that is across the road from the house! The kitchen floor is pretty! The house was built in 1890. It is located on .59 acre in Franklin, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, updated kitchen with pretty flooring, knotty pine, wood floors, built-in bookshelves, large fireplace, wainscoting and updated bathrooms. The house has a new roof and new HVAC. This is a real pretty area of the North Carolina mountains. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms. $339,000 Contact Ma

item.title: In the Outer Banks! Kitchen dreams! C. 1930. $539,000
item.description: In the Outer Banks! How about that kitchen! So much natural light! The house was built in 1930. It is located on .3 acre in Kitty Hawk, North Carolina. The house features a screened in front porch, a screened in back porch, covered side porch, updated kitchen with soaring ceilings, wood floors, wainscoting and a great bathroom with claw foot tub and balcony. There is a detached garage with a full bathroom on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,866 square feet. $539,000 Contact Carl

item.title: Check out the staircase! Circa 1925. One acre in Virginia. $199,000
item.description: Check out the staircase and the coved window valance! Beautiful woodwork! The house was built in 1885. (they say 1925, there is no way.) It is located on 1.02 acres in Pearisburg, Virginia. The house features covered porches, wide baseboards, coved windows with architectural valance, wood floors and a grand staircase. I sure wish they had better pictures and more pictures. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,432 square feet. $199,000 Contact Chad Price with Coldwell Banker Townside: 540-558-8774

item.title: Beautiful details! Circa 1873. One acre in Wisconsin. $249,900
item.description: There are some really beautiful details inside this home! The house was built in 1873. It is located on one acre in Oshkosh, Wisconsin. The house features a covered side porch, wood floors, wide baseboards, updated kitchen, wainscoting, pretty staircase, crown moulding, pocket doors, ceiling medallions, great windows, vintage light fixtures, picture rails and built-in bookshelves. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,580 square feet. $249,900 Contact Jaimee A. Radloff with Roots Real Estate: Ja

item.title: Cute Wyoming house! Original details inside! C. 1911. $259,000
item.description: This is a cute house in Wyoming! There are a lot of original details inside! Love the sunroom. The house was built in 1911. It is located in Sheridan, Wyoming. The house features a screened in front porch, wood floors, built-in bookshelves, brick fireplace, wide baseboards, sunroom, solid wood doors, vintage bathroom sink and built-in buffet seating in the kitchen. There is a detached garage on the property. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,613 square feet. $259,000 Contact Kathryn Hamil with

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Love this house! C. 1848 in Alabama. $90,000
item.description: I love this house! What a fun project this would be! So many amazing details! The house was built in 1848. It is located on .85 acre in Marion, Alabama. The house features a huge foyer, original fretwork, tall ceilings, wood floors, wide baseboards, picture rails, original mantels, vintage light fixtures and a spacious kitchen. There is an english basement. This is a lot bigger than it looks! Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 5,880 square feet. $90,000 Contact Bart Stanley with Home Team Realty

item.title: On 13 acres in Arkansas! Nice interior! C. 1908. $164,900
item.description: This has a nice interior! Nice acreage too! The house was built in 1908. It is located on 13 acres in Williford, Arkansas. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, log walls, corner cabinet and crown moulding. There are a couple of outbuildings and a carport for an RV. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,008 square feet. $164,900 Contact J. item.title: Storybook cottage! Circa 1938 in California. $299,000
item.description: This looks like a storybook cottage! It has character! The house was built in 1938. It is located in Twin Peaks, California. The house features nice landscaping, knotty pine, exposed beams, wainscoting and a stone fireplace. It has a private backyard. There is a large deck area and storage.
